control.note: No automatic restart or heavy final processing after protective stop. Preserve latest complete checkpoint.

plan.deadline_policy: Stop at cumulative 5 epochs or the fixed 18-hour training guard, whichever is first. Final cleanup has a separate 30-minute allowance. Never move these deadlines or auto-restart after thermal/monitor stop.

training.backend: Actual C ABI with unchanged validated FP32 full-softmax kernels
training.output_policy: Separate exact-state continuation; preserve the completed night run and stopped old 14-hour queue.

readiness_requirements: Independent full-size C/Torch numerical gate passed: 28 comparisons.

observed_hardware_snapshot.pmset_report: No thermal or performance warning level recorded at inspection.
observed_hardware_snapshot.scope: Read-only current-state inspection, not a load test, hardware diagnosis or overnight safety certification.

plan.timing_evidence_limits: Previous 7.42h two-epoch estimate used SIX requested threads and short low-load C observations. It does not predict this four-thread configuration or ensure completion by morning.
plan.physical_confirmation: Existing user confirmation in this thread: ventilated solid desk, no observed physical abnormalities. Reused for the explicitly authorized continuation; current exterior not remotely observed.

thermal_policy.source: macOS ProcessInfo.thermalState; system thermal pressure, not a temperature or fire sensor
thermal_policy.on_serious: Stop new training updates, best-effort atomic checkpoint, exit with thermal-stop reason.
thermal_policy.on_critical: Stop compute immediately; preserve latest complete checkpoint. Do not continue evaluation/generation.
thermal_policy.on_monitor_error: Stop training rather than treating missing monitoring as normal.
thermal_policy.limitations: Software thermal monitoring does not certify battery/charger safety or prevent every possible fire.

run.math: FP32 full-softmax NPLM with dense AdamW; no sampled softmax or Word2Vec
run.timing: Actual elapsed time including setup, evaluation and checkpoint I/O; absolute morning deadlines.
run.scope: Exact full-state continuation of the same CPU4 H128/V35328/B512 run. Elapsed seconds are cumulative active trainer time and exclude the offline pause. Same evaluation targets and prompts; no vocabulary/model-quality optimum claim.
